topic: Sign-up data model: Lead object vs custom Sign-Up object with lead stage
note: Lead object dropped (L0563, 6/23); leads and sign-ups are one Sign-Up object with a lead/New stage (L1071, 7/17). L1165 (tier2, 7/21) restates it after the client mockup asked for a separate read-only lead object.

Every click is kept and rolled up to one Sign-Up (L1304, 7/24). On 9/30 the duplicate rule was stated as same player + same deal regardless of rep (L3443); Kobi to verify the SLC logic matches (L3445). Earlier per-click and staging-object options are superseded.

topic: Sign-Up status model and fraud handling
note: Won't Do and Fraud were first merged into a Flag status (L0878, L0987, L1105), then Flagged was removed and fraud is tracked separately via Fraud Flag + Fraud Review Status (L1221, L1225, 7/22). Final status set: New, In Progress, Completed, Archived.

topic: New to In Progress transition on Log Sign Up
note: 7/22 rule (Log Sign Up moves to In Progress with no input) was reversed: a field must change, otherwise it stays New with a warning (L2407 9/3 internal tier1; L2479 9/11 client sync).

topic: Sign-Up completion: auto-complete and Ops override
note: Log Sign Up may set Completed when all info is filled (accepted 9/1, L2270). Ops can complete below 100% (L2337, restated internally). Earlier 'manual Complete only' position (recorded in WAGR-243) is superseded.

topic: Fraud dismissal, confirmation and record lock
note: Dismiss removes the flag and the record keeps its prior status; confirm locks reps out (L2306, 9/1). L0988's 'unflag returns to In Progress' and the Gemini note L1878 are superseded.

topic: Fraud write-off and auto-archive on confirmed fraud
note: 9/1 decided: confirmed fraud + Payment Sent -> Write-off checkbox; confirmed fraud without payment on a New record -> Archived (L2308). Follow-up on how write-offs roll into payouts/redeposits is open (L3374, 9/30).

topic: Fraud flag presentation on Player record
note: Separate filtered fraud list (L2046, tier2 proposed) replaced by fraud columns on the Sign-Ups related list (L2622, tier2 decided 9/16, Emily's proposal reported second-hand). No tier1 decided item; L2591 is proposed.

topic: Ops control to reverse/confirm fraud flag
note: 9/23 Kobi agreed to a button/action for Ops covering both confirm and dismiss (L2933).

7/22: reps see operator only, no partner (L1204). 9/23: reps get partner short code in header (L2921), full partner name on deal hover (L2920) and a Deal Information section with deal name (L2922). L1204 is reversed in part.
7/22 header set (L1207) refined on 9/23: attribution in header for all statuses (L2912), proof status/completion far right (L2919), partner short code (L2921).

8/27 client session: sign-up payout currency defaults from the Deal market country (CAD/USD), stamped on the sign-up (not a player formula), editable by Ops (L2125, L2128, L2138). CONFLICT: L2704 (9/18, internal tier1) says the sign-up currency formula was pointed at CurrencyIsoCode to capture the player's country 'as agreed on Slack'; this is not a client meeting decision and contradicts L2128.

Two dates: agency registration date from player (renamed L1351) and rep-entered Sign Up Date (relabelled L1350). 9/23: Sign Up Date not prefilled from click date (L2925); no future dates (L2926); deposit/wager not before sign-up date (L2927).

topic: First bet vs First Wager Date
note: First bet date/amount removed from Log Sign Up (L1190, 7/22); First Wager Date added as the wager proof date (L2201/L2203, 8/31).
No Refer checkbox and referral notes evolved; 9/23 decided referral notes become a general full-width Notes section and No Referral moves up (L2930), replacing the 9/1 placement (L2313).

8/11 test plan matched deals by operator/partner name or ID (L1637). 8/25: remove deal-makeup (country/state) logic and rely on Deal ID (L2073) with graceful error handling (L2072). 9/1: clicks without Deal External ID cannot be reprocessed (L2300).
Flag SLCs without a player ID for ops (L1487, decided). L1486 (external-ID only matching) is proposed and was not confirmed in a later meeting.
Missing data flagged and reprocessed (L1342); unconfigured agents flagged, no sign-up (L1912); BA mismatch flagged for ops (L1973).

Earlier 'no VIP on sign-up' (L2051 tier2) reversed by L2945. VIP manual entry decided 9/23 (button back, one-screen custom flow, starts In Progress) and refined 9/30 (BA defaults to current user, active+paused deals, duplicate block, link creation inside the flow).
9/23: do not offer Kanban at launch (L2940). Jira WAGR-430 later records a client confirmation (outside a meeting) that Kanban stays visible because it cannot be hidden natively.
Payout code generation deferred to the payouts phase (L1507, 8/4).
Payment Sent checkbox added (L1509). L3145 (9/25) says the system does not track money sent to players for deposits or a BMO ID; the relationship to the Payment Sent checkbox is not stated.

L0861 (7/8): nothing logged within 3 days -> past due. L1107 (7/17): flagged/archived records are not past due. L1108 (proposed) suggests past due applies to in-progress records; no later decided item defines whether New records go past due.
Path removed (L1171, tier2 decided 7/21); L1219 left re-adding a linear path open with no decision.
Deferred as low priority on 9/1 (L2239).
No sign-up flow logic needed; banned referrers are selectable (L3038); WAGR-75 reworked to a report (L3039).
Salesforce does not block sign-ups for banned players (L1980, 8/18); CMS side prevents completion (L1909); 9/11 confirmed banned players stay banned while sign-ups flow (L2477).
9/25: sign-up payout type and currency default from the referrer, BA can override (L3106, L3120).
Fraud tool API integration is a fast follow, not Phase 1 (L1560). L1558 (welcome email moves sign-up to In Progress) is proposed only.
